refit_without_13_files.order_of_events: The session lead's instruction to leave the thirteen files out of every fit and score was sent before the fits and did not reach the implementing agent before the main readout had been run (17:04) and read. The main readout uses the beam columns as delivered, as the registration reads; its statement table is the judged one. The refit was run afterwards under the validity rule, with every number of the main readout known (Addendum 1 sections 11 to 13).
refit_without_13_files.rule: a file-source pair (sources NB1B, NB1C, NB2A, NB2B, NB2C) is invalid if its power column is above 5.0 MW or below -0.1 MW in any grid row of the file
